topography.project_purpose: Centrifuge is a decentralized protocol that bridges real-world assets (RWA) into DeFi by tokenizing them into on-chain vaults and pools. It enables asset originators to finance real-world collateral and investors to earn yield from RWA-backed lending.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Centrifuge Protocol family provides the cross-chain hub-and-spoke infrastructure that connects all vaults and pools. Vaults rely on the protocol's messaging and adapter layer for cross-chain operations, while governance contracts manage parameters and access control across the entire system.
